# postyour.art

> The curated artist network with a real foundation in Worpswede, Germany: artists apply with
> their works, curation decides admission — not budget. Members publish for free on findyour.art
> (art as walkable 3D worlds), join a real contact pool for exhibitions, projects and buyers,
> and can book personal support from an artist agency. No subscription, no paid visibility —
> quality over quantity. A service by mas.art (Lippeck GmbH, Worpswede, Germany).

Worpswede roots: the network is at home in Worpswede, the world-famous artists' colony that has
drawn painters, sculptors and dreamers for more than 130 years and is alive today with museums,
galleries and studios. mas.art lives and works there with its own rooms, exhibitions and
relationships grown over years — a local reputation and name that opens doors, and the
foundation for carrying each artist's work into the world. An exhibition in Worpswede is a
lasting line in an artist's biography.

Who is behind it: Anna Schill and Markus Lippeck (mas.art = short for their two names). Anna Schill
— painter and art teacher, studied fine art at the Novosibirsk Academy of Arts, classical oil and
watercolour, figurative and symbolic; chair of Schluh.art e. V. Markus Lippeck — self-taught artist,
gallerist and curator, first exhibition 1989 (Berlin, Krefeld, Bremen, Munich, Worpswede), works
between photography, print, paper and AI; curates Galerie SCHLUH and builds findyour.art and
postyour.art. The house in Worpswede (Im Schluh 71) holds gallery, studio, library and five
apartments for artist residencies. Schluh.art e. V. is a non-profit art association founded in
2024; through the Worpswede artists' colony it is part of euroart (47 artists' colonies in 13
countries) and is building an exchange with the partner town Olevano Romano, Italy.
Details: https://findyour.art/mas-art · https://findyour.art/schluh-art

Why the network exists:

- Organic social media reach does not sell art: years of posting typically produce entertainment
  for the platform, not promotion for the artist's work. Industry analyses report reel reach
  down ~35% and organic reach down ~14% within a year.
- On ad platforms, visibility is rented: who does not pay stays invisible. postyour.art is the
  counter-model — a network where curation decides admission, not budget.
- Artists need the right contacts, not follower counts: people, places and opportunities that
  open real doors — self-controlled presence, exhibitions, credible references for the biography.

How to join (two paths, one principle — quality over quantity):

- Curated admission (free): apply with your works, personal curation instead of an algorithm.
  Includes free publication on findyour.art as a walkable 3D experience, admission to the
  network's contact pool (visible for exhibitions, projects and buyers), and the postyour.art
  vault and tools. No subscription, no hidden costs. Curation decides — not your budget.
- Artist agency (individual, limited places): personal support by mas.art — strategy, selection
  and development, exhibitions and projects (including Worpswede, a place of art-historical
  significance), applications for competitions, grants and exhibitions, press and public
  relations, access to the real network (associations, organizers, international contacts),
  references that stay in the artist's biography. Concrete projects with transparent costs
  instead of paid visibility. Individual offer: markus@lippeck.de

Tools members get (the postyour.art app):

- Capture works entirely via Telegram (photo + voice message) or in the browser — no new app to
  learn. AI structures title, technique, dimensions, price and the story behind each piece into
  a private, exportable vault.
- Live capture: camera and microphone run during a studio session; the app transcribes speech in
  real time, automatically saves keyframes at intervals and writes interim summaries. In three
  stages (recording → location & web → finished product) the AI turns the session into a studio
  report or article with photos, original quotes and the full transcript.
- The vault stores: gallery of works (technique, dimensions, price, motif, color palette, style
  tags), stories, dates/exhibitions, full history, and an archive of folders and albums
  (sketches, processes, press, documents) with automatic AI categorization and search.
- Data ownership promise: full ZIP export any time, permanent account deletion, no AI training on
  user data, no advertising use. AI processing only on explicit user command. No data leaves the
  artist's personal space.
- One-click social media connection: through the central postyour.art API every artist connects
  their own accounts (Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest and more) with a single click and posts
  straight from the app — no API setup, no downloads, no storing or editing outside the app.
- Channels (automated publishing from the vault): print/PDF catalogs and labels, personal artist
  website, Instagram/Pinterest/YouTube/Facebook, Canva-integrated designs, Google presence,
  Shopify, selling on findyour.art, and a personal artist agency for competition and exhibition
  applications.
- findyour.art (companion platform, live): the collector-facing counterpart to postyour.art — an
  online shop fed directly from the vault. Works the artist releases appear for sale with photos,
  technique, tags and price; an AI gallery copywriter writes each product page from the vault's
  semantic knowledge (one paragraph on the work, one on the artist); every artist automatically
  gets their own collection page. Updates sync without duplicates and nothing goes live without
  the artist's approval. Presentation is free; commission only applies when a work sells.
  Presentation form: walkable 3D worlds instead of a catalog shop — an infotainment experience
  (live example: https://findyour.art/kuenstler/markus-lippeck), later also planned for TV and VR.
  Next stage: matching interested buyers to artworks and artists by preference and taste, up to
  individual, semantically rich presentations per visitor.
- Languages: English (default), German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian —
  each at https://www.postyour.art/?lang=de|fr|es|it|pt|ru

FAQ (short answers, also on the page at https://www.postyour.art/#faq):

- What is postyour.art? The entry to a curated artist network: apply with your works, after
  curation publish for free on findyour.art and join the contact pool. The vault is part of it:
  capture works by photo and voice, AI structures everything — free, exportable, the artist's
  property.
- What does it cost? Taking part in the network and the vault are free — curation decides
  admission, not budget. No subscription. Personal support by the artist agency is booked
  individually: concrete projects with transparent costs, offer via markus@lippeck.de.
- Who owns the data? The artist. No third-party AI training, no advertising use, full ZIP export
  and permanent deletion at any time.
- How is a work captured? Photo plus two spoken sentences, in the browser or via Telegram; the
  AI assistant structures everything. No new app to learn.
- What are channels? Automated publishing from the vault: PDF catalogs/labels, artist website,
  social media, Canva, Shopify, selling on findyour.art, artist agency for applications.
- What is findyour.art? The collector-facing counterpart: art as a walkable 3D experience;
  released works are for sale there; presentation free, commission only on sale.
- Languages? Seven: German, English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian.
